sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This policy applies to Global NovaTech staff and authorized stakeholders. Asset Allocation is maintained by OPS Operations.

sections.heading: Policy requirement
sections.text: Laptops and monitors assigned asset IDs and custody acknowledgment.

sections.heading: Implementation steps
sections.text: 1. Log the request, business purpose, owner, and applicable region. 2. Verify the current policy version and eligibility. 3. Obtain the designated approval before execution. 4. Record the outcome and evidence in the department tracking system. 5. Escalate exceptions to OPS Operations.

sections.heading: Worked example
sections.text: A staff member asks about asset allocation. The reviewer checks the rule above, validates employee scope, records approvals, and follows the related procedure in HR-007. Do not use superseded guidance for current requests.

sections.heading: Controls and exceptions
sections.text: Exceptions need written approval from OPS Operations. Confidential or Restricted material must only be retrieved for entitled roles. The owning team reviews the policy annually.

sections.heading: Cross-department handoff
sections.text: For overlapping questions, consult HR-007. If policies disagree, use the active version effective on the relevant date and escalate unresolved conflicts to the owners.
